sentiment.rationale: This pre-earnings digest describes depressed expectations heading into the print: the 2026 EPS forecast fell from $3.65 to $3.29 over the trailing 60 days, and the CEO warned of a 'year of price pressure.' This lowered bar increases the odds of a positive surprise reaction. Offsetting positives include the FDA approval and commercial launch of oral Wegovy, a genuine catalyst, and a trailing four-quarter track record of three beats with an average surprise of +11.6%, which gives some investors reason to expect an upside surprise. Overall, expectations appear more depressed than stretched, supporting a mildly bullish score.
